items.title: Bayer wins £1.76m, 10-year deal to standardise PET-CT auto-injectors across four NHS Scotland boards
items.summary: NHS National Services Scotland has awarded Bayer a single, non-framework 10-year contract worth £1.76m to supply, maintain and provision consumables for auto-injector systems standardising radiopharmaceutical delivery across PET-CT services at NHS Greater Glasgow and Clyde, NHS Lothian, NHS…

items.title: Hologic wins direct-award mammography maintenance renewal at Somerset NHS Foundation Trust
items.summary: Somerset NHS Foundation Trust has directly awarded Hologic a maintenance contract worth £187,901.38 to cover 12 Hologic mammography devices at Musgrove Park Hospital and off-site locations, running from May 2027 to March 2028.

items.title: Nottingham rolls out MRI central vein sign test for MS diagnosis, cutting lumbar punctures
items.summary: University of Nottingham reports an NHS trust has implemented a T2*-weighted MRI 'central vein sign' test in its MS diagnostic pathway, adding about six minutes of scan time instead of a lumbar puncture. Scanning before first clinic cut average time to diagnosis from 5.6 to 2.9 months.

items.title: NHS North East London ICB: Newham Community Diagnostic Centre (CDC 5) market engagement event
items.summary: NHS North East London Integrated Care Board invites suitably qualified providers to a market engagement event ahead of tendering community diagnostic services for Newham CDC 5 (notice 088650-2026).
